name: MiniMax H3 Image (Official, beta)
description: Official Draw Things preset for MiniMax H3 Image — a 16MP image model (beta)
notes: BETA / UNVERIFIED: copied verbatim from the official app export (minimax_h3_image_i4x.ckpt): 6 steps, TFG 1, DDIM Trailing, shift 3, 4096x4096 = 16MP without an upscaler. Kontext-style reference model — up to 16 reference images, addressed in the prompt as <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>; strength must stay 1.0. resolutionDependentShift is absent from the export (= off). NOT yet present on the .150 server and gRPC support is unconfirmed, so expect a server error until both land. 4096x4096 will not fit a 12GB card with tiling off; use a smaller aspect ratio or expect a memory kill.
